object.en: She also studied the power of different types of radiation to penetrate different objects.
object.zh: 她还研究了不同类型的辐射穿透不同物体的能力。

object.en: But unlike colour terms, it doesn't really seem to be about the object it's describing.
object.zh: 但和颜色词不同的是，这些词似乎并不是在描述被形容对象本身的客观属性。

object.en: In other words, he was crazy. Kaczynski, however, fiercely objected to this strategy.
object.zh: 换句话说，他是个疯子。然而，卡钦斯基强烈反对这一策略。

object.en: If all of the parts are changed, is it still the same object?
object.zh: 如果所有的零件都换了，它还是同一个物体吗？

object.en: Should museums have the right to keep objects taken during periods of inequality or colonial rule?
object.zh: 博物馆是否有权保留在不平等或殖民统治时期掠夺来的物品？

objective.en: The major objective was allowing people to dive down and recover valuables from shipwrecks.
objective.zh: 主要目标是让人类能够潜入水下并从沉船中打捞贵重物品。

objective.en: Subjective things are based on your own personal opinions and feelings rather than objective facts.
objective.zh: subjective(主观的)的事物，是基于你个人的看法和感受，而非客观事实。

objective.en: The adverb subjectively means in a way that's based on your personal experience rather than objective facts.
objective.zh: 副词 subjectively（主观地）意味着以一种基于你个人经验而非客观事实的方式。

objective.en: This referred to a time when objective facts seemed to matter less than emotions or personal beliefs.
objective.zh: 这个词指的是这样一个时代：客观事实似乎变得不如情绪或个人信念重要。

objective.en: They don't feel so cold. Subjectively means based on your personal inner experience rather than objective facts.
objective.zh: 他们不觉得那么冷。Subjectively（主观地）意味着基于你个人的内心体验，而不是客观事实。

obviously.en: It’s been fun. Eye-opening. A world away from his hometown of Cincinnati, Ohio, obviously.
obviously.zh: 这趟旅程很有趣，也很开眼界，和他的家乡——俄亥俄州辛辛那提——简直是两个世界，这是不言而喻的。

obviously.en: I think sometimes it can be quite convenient, obviously because it's quick, but not really.
obviously.zh: 我认为有时候它确实很方便，明显是因为它很快，但也说不上多喜欢。

obviously.en: Doctors and nurses and other regulated health professionals are obviously not affected by this change.
obviously.zh: 医生、护士和其他受监管的医疗专业人员显然不受此变化影响。

obviously.en: Like obviously you're involved, but motivated reasoning is the worst kind of reasoning.
obviously.zh: 就像显然你参与其中，但动机性推理是最糟糕的推理。

obviously.en: And I know this obviously from the fitness world, but it applies to everything.
obviously.zh: 我从健身领域显然明白这一点，但这适用于所有事情。

observe.en: They observed birds knowing that some species only fly a certain distance from shore.
observe.zh: 他们观察鸟类，知道某些物种只在离海岸一定距离的范围内飞行。

observe.en: No spacecraft has ever been to Psyche before, so the plan is to go and observe it.
observe.zh: 此前没有任何飞船去过 Psyche，所以计划是去实地观测它。

observe.en: Like, yes, it's going to trigger you, but observe for a moment that like, it's triggering me.
observe.zh: 没错，这些确实会触发你的情绪，但请观察片刻，意识到“这正在触发我的情绪”。

observe.en: He was responsible for observing, collecting, and recording plants, animals, rocks, and fossils along the journey.
observe.zh: 他负责在旅途中观察、收集和记录动植物、岩石以及化石。

observe.en: But you reflect on the problems to observe them and solve them.
observe.zh: 但你反思问题是为了观察它们并解决它们。

obligation.en: Where do we draw the line between personal freedom to choose and the government’s obligation to protect?
obligation.zh: 我们应该在个人选择自由与政府保护义务之间如何划定界限？

obligation.en: A jury is none of those things. It is twelve people chosen at random, with no career to protect, no deference to authority, and no obligation to the government.
obligation.zh: 陪审团则完全不同。它是十二个随机选出的人，没有职业生涯需要顾及，不会对权威唯命是从，也不对政府负有任何义务。

obligation.en: I also get the sense too that maybe people have lived obligation life for so long that they actually kind of struggle to tap into what it is that they want.
obligation.zh: 我也感觉到，也许人们过这种“义务生活”太久了，以至于他们实际上很难触及他们真正想要的是什么。

obligation.en: And then, things got even worse. The thing that took this problem and turned it into a crisis was something else that was new, something called a collateralized debt obligation, a CDO.
obligation.zh: 然后，情况变得更糟了。把这个问题演变成危机的是另一件新鲜事，一种被称为债务担保凭证（CDO）的东西。

obligation.en: But because their employers have met their legal obligations, they can wash their hands of the situation, saying “we’re paying what we need to do”, rather than paying a fair and honest wage to their workers.
obligation.zh: 但由于雇主已经履行了法律义务，他们就可以对这种情况撒手不管，说“我们已经支付了该付的钱”，而不是向工人支付公平诚实的工资。

obvious.en: But it’s not something that everyone knows, and it’s not something that’s immediately obvious.
obvious.zh: 但并不是所有人都知道这件事，而且它也不是一眼就能看出来的。

obvious.en: Language is the most obvious, the most visible, the most measurable sign of this.
obvious.zh: 语言是最明显、最直观、最可衡量的标志。

obvious.en: I can remember the one where it became obvious to do the podcast was Dana White.
obvious.zh: 我记得很清楚，做播客变得显而易见的那一次是Dana White。

obvious.en: The economic rationale for this is pretty obvious; a landlord can typically make much more money.
obvious.zh: 背后的经济逻辑相当明显；房东通常能赚到更多钱。

obvious.en: It became obvious to her only when it finally affected her work.
obvious.zh: 直到它最终影响到她的工作，她才意识到这一点。

objection.en: The most serious objection is that participants may not have fully believed the shocks were real.
objection.zh: 最严重的质疑是：参与者可能并没有完全相信电击是真实的。

objection.en: In von Stauffenberg’s case, several historians have suggested that he had a strong moral objection to the treatment of Jews.
objection.zh: 就冯·施陶芬贝格而言，几位历史学家指出他对犹太人的待遇有着强烈的道义反对。

objection.en: Well, here's Adam Frank again, answering these objections on BBC World Service programme, CrowdScience: What happens is somebody else will pick up on their work, either affirming it and showing new evidence for it or pushing back on it, and once you get to, like, 20, 30 or 40 papers, then you have a consensus.You're like, "OK.
objection.zh: 嗯，亚当·弗兰克又来了，他在BBC世界服务节目《CrowdScience》上回应了这些反对意见：发生的情况是，其他人会接着他们的工作继续研究，要么是肯定它并展示新的证据，要么是提出反对意见，一旦你积累了比如20篇、30篇或40篇论文，你就会形成一个共识。你会觉得：“好吧。

obsession.en: And, in a sense, Fawcett’s obsession may not have been in vain.
obsession.zh: 从某种意义上说，Fawcett 的执念或许并非徒劳。

obsession.en: So, could our modern obsession with protein mean that we ignore other important food groups, like fibre?
obsession.zh: 那么，我们对蛋白质的现代痴迷是否意味着我们忽略了其他重要的食物类别，比如纤维？

obsession.en: But this underlines our obsession with the idea of secret societies.
obsession.zh: 但这突显了我们对秘密社团这种概念的痴迷。

obsession.en: Now the global pool of money has the exact opposite obsession.
obsession.zh: 现在，全球资金池有了完全相反的痴迷。

obsession.en: And then, perhaps most famously, came his obsession with divinity.
obsession.zh: 然后，也许最为人所知的是，他对神性的痴迷。

obey.en: But to stay in the privilege cell, prisoners had to obey the guards without question.
obey.zh: 但要想留在特权牢房，囚犯就必须无条件服从狱警。

obey.en: Some became passive, obeying every command without question.
obey.zh: 有些人变得被动顺从，对每一个命令都言听计从。

obey.en: A good citizen obeys the law of the land – a term for the set of rules and laws that exists in a country.
obey.zh: 一个好公民会遵守当地的法律——这是对一个国家现行法律法规的总称。

obey.en: The president would be elected. They would serve for a limited term, and they could be removed from office, and they had to obey a written constitution.
obey.zh: 总统将通过选举产生。他们任期有限，可以被罢免，并且必须遵守成文宪法。

obey.en: And so if you want to operate in a high trust society, you need to have sets of rules that people need to follow and obey so they get along, even if they're, you know, one size fits all, doesn't work for everybody.
obey.zh: 所以如果你想在一个高信任社会中运作，你需要有一套人们需要遵循和服从的规则，这样他们才能相处，即使它们是……你知道，一刀切，并不适合所有人。

obedience.en: Now, Milgram published his findings in 1963, and later in a book, Obedience to Authority, in 1974.
obedience.zh: 米尔格拉姆在1963年发表了这项研究的成果，后来又在1974年出版了专著《服从权威》(Obedience to Authority)。

obedience.en: He had been contemplating the idea of obedience, and specifically, the German people's compliance with the Nazi regime.
obedience.zh: 他一直在思考“服从”这个概念，尤其是德国民众对纳粹政权的顺从。

oblige.en: Fortunately for Abdallah, Bob Denard is more interested in getting paid than in holding a grudge, and he is more than happy to oblige.
oblige.zh: 对 Ahmed Abdallah 来说幸运的是，Bob Denard 对拿钱比记仇更感兴趣，非常乐意效劳。

oblige.en: Interest on government debt is the interest the US government pays on its bonds, which it is obliged to pay to maintain faith in the US dollar.
oblige.zh: 政府债务利息是指美国政府为其债券支付的利息，这是维护美元信誉所必须支付的。

obstacle.en: And then he runs into one obstacle. He runs into another obstacle.
obstacle.zh: 然后他遇到了一个障碍。接着又遇到了另一个障碍。

obstacle.en: And then he runs into one obstacle. He runs into another obstacle.
obstacle.zh: 然后他遇到了一个障碍。接着又遇到了另一个障碍。

obstacle.en: Remove any obstacles or friction. Make your habits obvious.
obstacle.zh: 消除任何障碍或阻力。让你的习惯显而易见。

obstacle.en: They aren't obstacles that block our path.
obstacle.zh: 它们不是挡在我们前进路上的障碍。

obstacle.en: Many did not. And over time, those who refused would increasingly be treated not as semi-independent rulers, but as obstacles to be subdued.
obstacle.zh: 许多人并不同意。随着时间的推移，那些拒绝的人越来越不被视为半独立的统治者，而是被视为必须征服的障碍。

observer.en: And I'll talk to myself. You know, I go, there's me and there's the observer.
observer.zh: 我会和自己对话。你知道，我说，有‘我’，还有‘观察者’。

observer.en: Like I'm the observer of my thoughts. I'm not the thoughts. and then I'll talk to myself.
observer.zh: 就像我是我思想的观察者。我不是那些思想。然后我会和自己对话。

observer.en: As the designer of the experiment, he should have been a neutral observer, but he was an active participant.
observer.zh: 作为实验的设计者，他本应是一个中立的观察者，但他却成了一个积极的参与者。

observer.en: To some observers, it was seen as yet more proof of how otherwise law-abiding, normal humans can do horrific things to each other.
observer.zh: 在一些观察者看来，这又一次证明了原本守法、正常的人，也可能对彼此做出可怕的事情。

observer.en: In April of 2001, the New York Observer reported that it had managed to gain access to the initiation ceremony, the event in which 15 new members were welcomed into the society.
observer.zh: 2001年4月，《纽约观察家报》（New York Observer）报道称，它设法进入了入会仪式，即15名新成员被欢迎加入该社团的活动。

obtain.en: With mounting evidence, the FBI obtained a search warrant for Ted Kaczynski's cabin in Montana.
obtain.zh: 随着证据越来越多，FBI 获得了搜查泰德·卡钦斯基在蒙大拿州木屋的搜查令。

obtain.en: First, there’s the cost of ingredients. Some of the world’s most famous perfumes contain materials that are incredibly rare and difficult to obtain.
obtain.zh: 首先是原料成本。世界上一些最著名的香水含有极其罕见且难以获得的材料。

obtain.en: For years, there have been growing calls to make it easier for these people to obtain Italian citizenship, to officially recognise their Italian identity, not just socially or culturally.
obtain.zh: 多年来，一直有越来越呼吁简化这些人获得意大利国籍的手续，以便在官方层面上承认他们的意大利身份，而不仅仅是在社交或文化层面上。

obedient.en: He flattered Tiberius; he never mentioned his father once, and he learned how to play the role of the obedient servant.
obedient.zh: 他奉承 Tiberius；他一次也没有提过自己的父亲，并且学会了扮演一个顺从的仆人。

obscure.en: Why is it that the intellectual explorers of the 20th century are so obscure?
obscure.zh: 为什么20世纪那些思想领域的探险家却如此默默无闻？

obscure.en: They're the very obscure suburbs that nobody ever talks about and nothing dramatic ever seems to happen there.
obscure.zh: 那是些极其偏僻的郊区，平时没人提起，也似乎从不会发生什么戏剧性的事情。

obscure.en: As I’m sure you know, there are podcasts about everything: comedy, TV shows, business, football, knitting, fishing, obscure historical periods, and, lest I forget, podcasts that help you learn a language.
obscure.zh: 相信大家都知道，播客的主题无所不包：喜剧、电视节目、商业、足球、编织、钓鱼、冷门的历史时期，当然，还有帮助你学习语言的播客。

observation.en: It creates a small gap between your conscious observation, self, and your mind.
observation.zh: 它在你的意识观察者、自我和你的思想之间创造了一个小小的间隙。

observation.en: But he did do a lot of experiments. He did lots of experimentation, lots of observation.
observation.zh: 但他确实做了很多实验。他做了大量的实验，进行了大量的观察。

observation.en: This system wasn’t really around when Leonardo Da Vinci was doing his experiments or his observations.
observation.zh: 当列奥纳多·达·芬奇做实验或观察时，这个系统其实并不存在。

observation.en: The 19th century was an exciting time in terms of space observation.
observation.zh: 对于太空观测而言，19世纪是一个激动人心的时代。

observation.en: And collected at multiple different points, it becomes harder to know where the observation should stop.
observation.zh: 并在多个不同点被收集时，就更难以知道这种观察应该在哪里停止。

obese.en: So about half a billion people are starving, and a billion people are obese.
obese.zh: 大约有五亿人在挨饿，而有十亿人肥胖。

obese.en: The average person is obese, likely to be divorced and has less than 1k in the bank.
obese.zh: 普通人超重，很可能会离婚，而且银行存款不到1000美元。

obese.en: There's twice as many people that are obese than are starving.
obese.zh: 肥胖人口是饥饿人口的两倍。

obese.en: The only way to become more successful than most people is to be willing to do something most people aren't willing to do. and this is that lean in mentality again it's like look it sucks it's shitty you're tired everybody says that you're leaving your friends behind leaving your family behind betraying your culture betraying whatever expectation it is that they have on you you need to do something that most people aren't willing to do because as we've said the average american is obese in debt and divorced like is that really oh brilliant fantastic i'm in the fucking center of the bell curve distribution here.
obese.zh: 成为比大多数人更成功的人的唯一方法是愿意做大多数人不愿意做的事情。这又是那种“倾斜”心态，就像：看，这很烂，这很糟糕，你很累，每个人都说你抛弃了朋友，抛弃了家人，背叛了你的文化，背叛了他们对你的任何期望，你需要做一些大多数人不愿意做的事情，因为正如我们所说，普通美国人肥胖、负债、离婚，这真的……哦，太棒了，太棒了，我正处于钟形曲线分布的中心。

obscene.en: I mean this sounds obscene, but I think it was the first month I got a $25,000 paycheck.
obscene.zh: 我的意思是这听起来可能有点荒唐，但我觉得就是我拿到25000美元月薪的那第一个月。
